headline: Special permit requests for a Walmart warehouse and garage projects on Tobey Avenue and Washington Street, plus a garage variance on Echo Lane.
summary: Four applications are on the agenda: three special permits and one variance. Walmart seeks a special permit for a warehouse use at 256 Pleasant St.
items: Special permit for a Walmart warehouse use at 256 Pleasant St. (2026-15)
Special permit for a new 2 car garage with mudroom entry at 11 Tobey Ave. (2026-16, Rui Costa for John and Jessica Musumarra)
Special permit to expand a nonconforming garage and attach 880 sq. ft. with an ADU above at 241 Washington St. (2026-17, Ethan Conley)
Variance for front and side yard setbacks to build a detached garage at 6 Echo Ln. (2026-18, Normand & Barbara Berube)
location: The Great Hall, 41 Pleasant St., Methuen, MA 01844
plain_text:
CITY OF METHUEN
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS
THE SEARLES BUILDING
41 PLEASANT ST, ROOM 203
METHUEN, MA 01844
MEETING AGENDA
41 PLEASANT ST, THE GREAT HALL
Wednesday November 18, 2026 at 7:00 PM
1) Pledge of Allegiance
2) Roll call
3) Acceptance of Minutes:
a) September 23,2026
4) Acceptance of 2027 Zoning Board of Appeals Meeting Schedule
5) New Business:
a) Application s for Special Permit:
i) 2026-15 Walmart
A Special Permit is required under Section V-D (table of use regulations) of the May 2025
Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance of the City of Methuen, in a BL (Limited Business) Zoning
District, for the proposed Warehouse use at 256 Pleasant St., Methuen MA 01844 (Parcel ID:
812-59-100).
ii) 2026-16 Rui Costa for John and Jessica Musumarra
Under section IX-E of the May 2025 Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance of the City of Methuen,
a Special permit is required from the Board of Appeals.  A proposed new 2 car garage, with 
mudroom entry, the requested side yard setback of the proposed extension to a 
nonconforming structure is 7.7 feet, where 15 feet is required; the requested rear yard setback
is 16.7 feet, where 20 feet is required at 11 TOBEY AVE, METHUEN, MA 01844 , 
RESIDENTIAL B ZONING DISTRICT (PARCEL ID: 1107-78A-50)  
iii) 2026-17 Ethan Conley
A Special Permit from the Zoning Board of Appeals is required to expand a pre-existing,
nonconforming accessory garage structure in a Single Family Residential (RA) District,
pursuant to Section IX-D of the May 2025 City of Methuen Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance.
Existing garage is 1,080 sq. ft. with a maximum allowed of 900 sq. ft. Request is to attach an
additional 880 sq. ft. with ADU above at 241 WASHINGTON ST, METHUEN MA (PARCEL
ID: 908-78E-67)
b) Application s for Variance:
i) 2026-18 Normand & Barbara Berube
A variance from the Zoning Board of Appeals is required for front and side yard setbacks to 
construct a detached garage in a Rural Residential (RR) District, per Appendix B (Table of 
Dimensional Regulations) of the May 2025 City of Methuen Comprehensive Zoning 
Ordinance. Front yard setback 40 ft required, 13 ft requested. Side yard setback 30 ft 
required, 4 ft requested at 6 ECHO LN, METHUEN MA (Parcel ID: 310-126A-14F)  
6) Adjournment
NEXT ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS MEETING: December 16 , 2026
